result.topic_en: Particular solutions of pairs of simultaneous quadratic equations of the form xx+2axy+cyy=A^2 and xx+2bxy+dyy=B^2, obtained by factoring the difference of squares and dividing by x-y.
result.transcription:
254 L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA. Arithmetica.
quae commode per $x-y$ divisa fit $(dd-1)(x-y)-2c(x+y)=0$, unde reperitur
$\frac{x}{y}=\frac{dd+2c-1}{dd-2c-1}$.
Sumatur ergo $x=dd+2c-1$ et $y=dd-2c-1$, fietque
$A+B=2(dd-1)$ et $A-B=4cd$, ergo $A=dd+2cd-1$ et $B=dd-2cd-1$.
Haec autem solutio tantum est particularis.
Problema. Resolvere has duas aequalitates:
$xx+2axy+nccyy=A^2$ et $xx+2bxy+nddyy=B^2$.
Solutio. Elimінetur littera $n$, quaerendo $A^2dd-B^2cc=xx(dd-cc)+2xy(add-bcc)$. Ponatur nunc
$Ad+Bc=x(d+c)$, eritque $Ad-Bc=x(d-c)+2y\left(\frac{add-bcc}{d+c}\right)$,
unde erit $2Ad=2dx+2y.\frac{add-bcc}{d+c}$, unde fit $A=x+y.\frac{add-bcc}{d(d+c)}$, quo valore substituto erit
$2ax+nccy=2x.\frac{add-bcc}{d(d+c)}+y\left(\frac{add-bcc}{d(d+c)}\right)^2$,
unde fit $\frac{x}{y}=\frac{(add-bcc)^2-nccdd(d+c)^2}{2cd(d+c)(ad+bc)}$.
A. m. T. II. p. 157.

74.
Resolutio aequationum
$xx+2axy+cyy=A^2$ et $xx+2bxy+dyy=B^2$.
Cum sit $A^2-B^2=2(a-b)xy+(c-d)yy$, sumatur $A-B=(a-b)y$, erit
$A+B=2x+\frac{c-d}{a-b}y$, hinc additis quadratis erit
$2(AA+BB)=4xx+4.\frac{c-d}{a-b}xy+\left(\frac{c-d}{a-b}\right)^2yy$
$+(a-b)^2yy$.
Cum igitur $2(AA+BB)=4xx+4(a+b)xy+2(c+d)yy$, inde sequitur
$4.\frac{c-d}{a-b}x-4(a+b)x+\left[\left(\frac{c-d}{a-b}\right)^2+(a-b)^2-2(c+d)\right]y=0$, hincque fit
$\frac{x}{y}=\frac{(c-d)^2+(a-b)^4-2(c+d)(a-b)^2}{4(a-b)(aa-bb-c+d)}$.
Sumi ergo poterit $x=(c-d)^2+(a-b)^4-2(c+d)(a-b)^2$ et $y=4(a-b)(aa-bb-c+d)$. Haec solutio differt ab ea, quae supra est tradita, ubi loco $c$ et $d$ habuimus $ncc$ et $ndd$, quod mirum non est, cum utraque solutio tantum sit particularis.
Eodem etiam modo hae aequalitates resolvi possunt
$(2+a)xx+(nn-4)xy+(2-a)yy=A^2$ et $(2+b)xx+(nn-4)xy+(2-b)yy=B^2$.
Facta enim simili operatione, dividi poterit per $x-y$, ac reperietur inde
$x=n^4-8nn+(a-b)^2+2nn(a+b)$ et $y=n^4-8nn+(a-b)^2-2nn(a+b)$.
In his autem formulis continetur casus supra tractatus, quando $n=2$.
A. m. T. II. p. 158.
